concept: SQS: buffering and decoupling producer/consumer during spikes
tests: Decoupling a synchronous service pair and absorbing load bursts with a queue.
expected: Checkout writes orders to SQS, the processor polls the queue and scales on its depth — no orders are lost. Triggers: "overwhelmed", "orders are lost", "flash sales", "decouple".
why_not: An ALB distributes load but does not buffer when all targets are saturated; a longer timeout still drops requests and blocks the producer; a bigger instance hits a vertical ceiling and keeps tight coupling.
